item.title: Who owns the beach? A heated battle plays out in the Florida Panhandle
item.description: After years of fighting over who gets to use the beach, and where, in Walton County, Florida, public-use advocates are calling for a state constitutional amendment to finally settle the matter.

item.title: Federal civil rights data about students is finally out. It's different under Trump
item.description: The Education Department gathers a massive tranche of civil rights data about public school students. It's now available but harder to parse than in the past.

item.title: Trump asks Supreme Court to lift block on USPS plan to restrict mail voting
item.description: The Trump administration has asked the Supreme Court to allow the U.S. Postal Service to carry out a plan for President Trump's attempt to restrict mail-in voting for the midterm election.
item.content:encoded: The Trump administration has asked the Supreme Court to allow the U.S. Postal Service to carry out a plan for President Trump's attempt to restrict mail-in voting for the midterm election.

item.title: Trump administration pushes to remove tax exemption for private colleges with DEI policies
item.description: The Trump administration is proposing a rule that would strip private schools and colleges of their tax-exempt status if they provide targeted help to students based on their race.

item.title: The Trump administration still aims to make state citizenship lists ahead of midterms
item.description: The Trump administration is taking the unprecedented step of creating lists of adult citizens who are eligible to vote in each state – but will not meet its own deadline 60 days before Election Day.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Leon Black defies subpoena to testify in Epstein inquiry and sues House panel
item.description: The billionaire investor is under two subpoenas from the House Oversight Committee. But in his lawsuit, Black says the panel doesn't have the authority to compel him to share nondisclosure agreements.

item.title: Later in life, Gloria Steinem found herself free of the 'demands of gender'
item.description: In 2015, the trailblazing feminist told Fresh Air she that had entered a new phase in life, one in which "you can do what you want." Steinem died Sept. 2 at the age of 92.
